payload.title: pr_manager.push_prepared_branch (the pr push verb with --no-dry-run) pushes an aria/* branch to the remote with no pr_create or pr_open profile gate and no approval check of its own, so the standard profile, which may not open a pull request, can still put a branch on GitHub
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/pr_manager.py:1088-1134 (push_prepared_branch reads the commit row, validates the branch name, runs git push when dry_run is false; the function holds no enforce_profile_for_action and no require_operator_approval call)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/runtime_profile.py:176-181 (pr_create and pr_open belong to strict and autonomous only; standard holds change_committed and change_validated)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/runtime_profile.py:204-205 (the table's own rule for standard: it mutates the store, not GitHub)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/recovery.py:81-89 (record_intent, the write before the push, goes through the profile-gated declared append of the external-effects ledger)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/runtime_profile.py:1111-1123 (the write gate: standard, strict and autonomous permit every known surface)
aria-kernel/tests/test_pr_manager_e2e.py:1371-1412 (the only push tests refuse the protected branches snowball and main; none pins a profile or approval refusal)
payload.rule_violated: CLAUDE.md make it impossible (tier 1) and the runtime-profile table (ACTION_PERMISSIONS): an action that changes GitHub is an action authority of strict and autonomous, and every step of the pipeline that reaches GitHub is enrolled in that table
payload.notes: Under the standard profile, pr_create is refused (it names strict and autonomous), yet `aria-kernel pr push --no-dry-run` on a proposal that has a commit row runs `git push -u origin` for its aria/* branch. The checks on that path are the existence of the commit row (whose own creation required operator approval) and the intent write to the external-effects ledger (recovery.py:81-89), a write the profile gate admits for standard (runtime_profile.py:1111-1123 permits every known surface to standard); approval is not re-read at push, so a proposal whose approval changed after the commit still pushes. The branch push is the GitHub-facing half of the same pipeline whose tail pr_create guards. Close condition: push_prepared_branch calls enforce_profile_for_action with the same action as pr_create (or a documented decision that a branch push is a standard authority, written in ACTION_PERMISSIONS as its own cell), and test_pr_manager_e2e.py gains a test that a real push (dry_run false) under the standard profile is refused with no git push executed, while strict still pushes. Verified at origin/main db10640f6.
